items.prompt: What does analytic vega establish about a finite volatility move with other model effects possible?

options.text: A local model derivative, not exact finite-bump PnL.
options.why: Higher-order terms, other changed inputs and model error can affect a finite move.

options.text: An exact gain equal to vega for any positive bump size.
options.why: The bump size and higher-order behavior cannot be ignored.

options.text: Authorization to submit a hedge trade.
options.why: A computed sensitivity is not trading authority.

options.text: A guaranteed market price change despite any model mismatch.
options.why: A model derivative does not guarantee an observed market outcome.

items.explanation: Higher-order terms, other changed inputs and model error can affect a finite move.
